# H4 — Sextant governance stack + vector adoption + the extraction-gap flywheel

**Mission** — Sextant (repo dir `../sextant`, Go module `github.com/geoffmilleraz/fathom`) is the fleet's ground-truth instrument, but compile spend is manifest-budgeted (M1) but has no kit telemetry/cost/replay stack, and enrichment is wholly ungoverned; its vector search duplicates kit code the kit already absorbed, and the evidence ladder's Tier-1 seam has no real adapter. Done means: every sextant LLM call flows through the kit's budget→cost→telemetry stack with a hashed, versioned prompt and a replayable cassette; sextant's hand-rolled vector code is deleted in favor of `vectorstore`; a fathom-index-backed `evidenceladder.Tier1` adapter exists as a design-note contract (Stage 5 is parked — see Deliverables); and the fleet index reflects the kit HEAD at run time. This closes the loop the north star demands: the tool that checks everyone else's claims now has its own claims checked — budget-bounded, cost-attributed, replay-verifiable, cache-honest.

**Repos & write scope** — Writes: `/Volumes/m2ext/code/geoffmilleraz/sextant` (code) and `/Volumes/m2ext/code/geoffmilleraz/agentic-kit` **ledger lines only** (TRACKING.md row flips + CHANGELOG note; no kit Go/CUE code — the kit side is already built). Read-only: `../throughline`, `../growing-gardens-bi`.

**Trigger** — NOT ready at authoring (2026-07-15). The sextant→vector-store deferral row (grep for the row text; ~line 350 at last audit): *"sextant→vector-store: 'Deferred. Sextant's feature branch is mid-flight; kit side ready. Subscribe-when: the branch merges and the embedding pipeline is wire-tested.'"* Before any work: `cd ../sextant && git branch --show-current` must print `main` (or the merge target) and `git status --porcelain` must be empty. Verified today it is NOT fired: branch `feat/mcp-scoped-surfaces`, dirty (`internal/analysis/docdrift/docdrift_test.go`, `internal/extractor/protoextract.go`). Do not build on the dirty branch; do not stash Geoff's work.

**Vision-fit audit (2026-07-16):** this spec is NEEDS-REVISION, not defunct. Three fractures fixed below: Stage 2's obligations half was defunct (M1 already shipped a strictly stronger TextHash-derived mechanism); Stage 5 conflicted with program law (zero Ladder consumers exist; parked); Stage 6's numeric grounding was stale (kit HEAD moved, TRACKING rows moved, the fleet index is not stale in the sense assumed). Stages 0, 1, 3, 4 survive with targeted line edits below.

## Design constraints

- **Sextant is a consumer, not the kit.** No new kit packages; if a kit seam is missing or awkward, STOP and file it as a friction entry for the pull queue (doctrine amendment 2) — do not fork kit code into sextant and do not "improve" kit packages from this spec.
- Budget wraps outermost (`WithBudget(WithCost(WithTelemetry(inner)))` reading inside-out) — a budget-refused call must cost and emit nothing; pin with a test.
- Injected clocks everywhere new time appears (`GovernConfig.Now`, `GapStore` clock); sextant tests use fixed clocks, no sleeps, no network (`NewMockClient`/`NewReplayClient` only).
- Keep sextant's existing cost provenance (`CompileRun.CostUSD`, tokens) untouched — the kit `costtracker` is additive observability, not a replacement ledger; double-entry is fine, silent replacement is not.
- Obligations prompt identity shipped in M1 via TextHash-derived `obligationsPromptVersion` (`internal/semantic/prompts.go`) — do not touch it. The enrich template (Stage 2) mirrors that doctrine: identity derives from `TextHash()[:8]`, never a hand-bumped `Version` string requiring a lockstep test.
- Tier-1 honesty is the whole point, if/when Stage 5 fires: the adapter must be incapable of producing a verdict — return `Signal`s only; never touch `PreconditionSatisfied` logic. Restate in the package doc.
- Concurrency contract in every new package doc (`internal/llm/governed.go`; `internal/ladder/*` if/when Stage 5's trigger fires). Org-agnostic rule binds the kit, not sextant, but keep model IDs and prices in sextant behind the existing `FATHOM_COMPILE_MODEL` seam + derived `PriceTable` — no new hardcodes.
- Layering: sextant imports kit foundations freely; nothing in this spec adds a kit→sextant edge (forbidden).

## Acceptance = proof (machine-checkable only)

1. Sextant: `task validate` green (fmt-check, vet, cue-vet, `go test ./...`); additionally `go test -race ./internal/llm/... ./internal/ladder/... ./internal/vector/... ./internal/query/...` green.
2. Donor deletion verified: `grep -rn "func cosineSimilarity\|func NewMemoryVectorStore" internal/vector/` → empty; adoption verified structurally, not by grep-for-a-string: `go list -f '{{.Imports}}' ./internal/vector` contains `github.com/geoffmilleraz/agentic-kit/foundations/embedding/vector-store` (comments can't satisfy this; `internal/fusion` is out of scope — it never imported `internal/vector`).
3. Interface/type proof — because `llmreplay.Scrubber` is a func type — the method-value binding `var _ llmreplay.Scrubber = (&redactorScrubber{}).Scrub` present. (The `evidenceladder.Tier1` compile assertion is dropped: Stage 5 is parked, so `ladder.IndexTier1` does not exist in this stage's scope.)
4. Budget canary: test asserting `errors.Is(err, llminstrument.ErrBudgetExceeded)` on an over-budget mock call, using an in-memory telemetry sink and the `Governor`'s tracker, and asserting BY CONTENT that both hold zero entries/events for the refused call — "telemetry didn't error" is not proof.
5. Prompt-drift pin, scoped to the enrich template only (the obligations template is out of scope — M1 already shipped it): a test asserting the derived version string (from `TextHash()[:8]`) in one golden, plus one fixed-params render golden asserting its `PromptHash` (fails on param-plumbing drift). Do NOT pin per-symbol render hashes.
6. agentic-kit: `task validate` + `constitution-lint` green (docs-only change must not break the plan-anchor grammar in this file if it lands under `docs/plans/`); `task downstream-check` green (sextant consumer builds against kit HEAD).
7. Fleet index proof: DuckDB queries per Stage 6 — indexed commit == `git -C ../agentic-kit rev-parse HEAD` at run time; retired symbol absent; indexed kit package count == `go list ./...` count from `../agentic-kit` HEAD at run time — capture the three query outputs in the PR body.
8. Cassette: if recorded, `TestEnrichReplaysCassette` runs un-skipped and green with network disabled; if not recorded, `grep -rn "H4" internal/llm/cassette_test.go` hits the skip message literal, and the `RecordEnrichCassette` wiring test (sentinel writer + mock) is green regardless.

## Non-goals & theater traps

- **Do NOT rebuild kit primitives in sextant**: `vectorstore` (exists, lifted FROM sextant), `evidenceladder.Ladder`/`Tier2`/`Tier3` (exist), `extractiongaplog` projections (exist), replay matching (exists, HashVersion2). Stage 5 is parked (2026-07-16): do not build `internal/ladder/` in this pass — if/when its trigger fires, it builds ONE adapter and ONE warm loop, nothing more.
- Do NOT implement Tier-2/Tier-3 or wire `kits/hitl` — the ladder doc explicitly leaves Tier-3 wiring to a future consumer workload; a Tier1 adapter with no Ladder run yet is the honest scope, if/when Stage 5 fires.
- Do NOT generate the cassette from `MockClient` output — a replay of a mock proves nothing; skip-with-reason beats fake determinism. (The Stage-3 wiring test's mock output goes to a sentinel writer, never to testdata.)
- Do NOT claim "governed" by wrapping in only one caller of `buildAnthropicClient` — the wrap goes INSIDE `buildAnthropicClient` (the single `anthropic.New` site), so `compile.go` and `servehttp.go` are governed together; both paths or neither.
- Do NOT touch `../sextant/bin/fathom` verify logic (H1's scope) and do not "fix" the dirty files Geoff has in flight if any remain.
- Trap: flipping TRACKING rows before the sextant commits exist. Flipped lines must carry the merge SHA in-line (Stage 6 regex) or they are overclaims (VISION: overclaiming = defect class equal to a failing test).

## Dependencies & hand-back

- **H1 (fathom `verify test_reaches` fix) landed 2026-07-08** — verify-mode is the default (same repo, branch-collision avoidance no longer a live concern for this reason). Its fix is what lets anchor claims here be machine-verified instead of hand-checked; the O9 residue (aliased test calls, re-ambiguated methods) is the only remaining fallback case — see grounding.
- Trigger dependency: Geoff (or the merged branch) must land `feat/mcp-scoped-surfaces`; this spec must not merge it for him.
- Hand-back to Geoff: (a) run `task record-cassettes` with his `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (cents-scale, and itself budget-governed via `Govern`) then re-run the replay test un-skipped; (b) sign off the default `FATHOM_LLM_BUDGET_USD=1.00` ceiling; (c) confirm the fleet re-ingest ran without clobbering a live session's DuckDB lock (backups exist at `workspace/db/*.bak-*`); (d) ratify the TRACKING row flips.

**Size & team** — L. Opus coordinator + 2 Sonnet implementers in two waves on disjoint file sets: Wave A = {Stage 1+2 (`internal/llm`, `cmd/fathom`), Stage 4 (`internal/vector` + `internal/query/engine.go`)} (Wave A's third implementer slot is dropped — Stage 5 is parked, see Deliverables); Wave B (serial, coordinator) = Stage 3 recording harness + Stage 6 re-ingest and ledger flips after Wave A merges.
